body.name: Ordered-ratio evaluated moment handle
body.construction: For each of the at most \(k!\) strict core-priority chambers, substitute ordered ratios \(t_r=x_r/x_{r+1}\) for \(r<k\) and \(t_k=x_k\). Starting from the nested-moment recurrence for identical attachments, construct a finite operator algebra indexed only by core order types, tag states, and shared future-prefix transformations; require direct rational routines for child multiplication, component multiplication, moving-endpoint integration, and coefficient extraction, with no stored vector of \(k\) independent degree totals and no unevaluated integration gate.
